description: Return a cleaned JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, or DOCX as base64, plus the fields that were removed. Image mode ai_only keeps camera EXIF and GPS. Mode all removes them too. PDF and Word files drop document properties in either mode.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes. A data URL is accepted.

file_url.description: Public http or https URL of a JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, or DOCX file.

filename.description: Original file name, used in the report.

mode.description: ai_only removes AI-generation and C2PA markers from an image and leaves camera EXIF and GPS. all also removes EXIF, GPS, XMP, and IPTC. PDF and Word files drop document properties in either mode. Default: all.

name: strip_metadata
